author: Mark Atwood
text: PARTIAL (worker3, timebox): corpus regeneration slice landed in commit 48c64007d1. Migrated reference_schnorr48.py ReferenceIdentity.ygg_addr to upstream AddrForKey + generate_ipv6_addresses.py + generate_dao_origin_signature.py, then regenerated: root_dio_signature.json, authenticated_schc_dio.json, tunnel_authorization.json, dao_origin_signature.json, ipv6-addresses.json. Also migrated yggdrasil-derivation.json (binding_invariant->binding_invariant_rejected) and yggdrasil_address.json (10 native entries -> upstream_addr_for_key). Python consumer tests updated (test_vectors.py binding-flip, test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py, test_yggdrasil_address_vectors.py). Verify: pytest tests/crypto+tests/ipv6 = 887 passed, 0 failed. Oracle: generators verified byte-equal to upstream yggdrasil-go@422836ee on fixed keys before regen; regen reproducible (RFC8032 deterministic nonce). REMAINING (filed as follow-up beads, discovered-from i72x.6): (1) Rust root_sig.rs flip (needs beads-worker-4 i72x.2 merge); (2) C rpl_root_sig local-vector resync; (3) address_collision.json + test_address_collision_vectors.py migration (filed separately — scenario semantics need op-by-op analysis, a mass-rebind regressed 3->8 and was reverted). NOTE: rpl/gateway/coap test dirs can't run in this env (pre-existing missing lora-medium dep, unrelated). The 12 root-DIO xfails I added under 7pt2 now PASS as XPASS-able — corpus is upstream so the staleness probe is inert.
